description: Start an advanced search: many keywords across many US places — the whole US, whole states or single places — run in the background in batches, each business charged once (1 lead), stopping at lead_cap if set. Estimate first with estimate_advanced_search and confirm with the user: it spends leads. Follow it with get_advanced_search; read its leads with query_leads or send them with export_leads (campaign_id). Up to 25 running or paused at once, and 40 new ones (or 250,000 searches) a day.

country.description: 'US' (the default), or a US territory's code ('PR', 'GU', 'VI', 'AS', 'MP') with a place from find_places.

everywhere.description: Every place in the US (or in the territory sent as country).

keywords.description: What to search for: up to 20 keywords or Google categories, each up to 100 characters. Each a string, or { keyword, exact } where exact keeps only businesses whose main Google category is that one.

lead_cap.description: Stop after this many unique, charged leads: a whole number from 100 to 1,000,000. Omit to search every place.

places.description: Single places by name ('Austin'), 'name, region' when a name is in several ('Springfield, Illinois'), or code (find_places). Up to 25,000 regions and places together; keywords × places may come to at most 50,000 searches.

regions.description: Whole US states, by name or code (find_places).

name: run_advanced_search

by_keyword.description: Each { keyword, exact, category, searches, searches_done, leads }.

estimate.description: { expected_leads, low, high, minutes } as estimated when it started.

finish_reason.description: all_searched | lead_limit | stopped once finished; null while it runs.

leads_with.description: How to read its leads: query_leads or export_leads with campaign_id.

resume_at.description: When a waiting search carries on by itself.

running_now.description: The newest batch running now: { keyword, places, status, verified, of }.

status.description: running | paused | completed | stopped. Paused by itself when a Free account runs out of leads (they don't renew: upgrade, then resume).

status_detail.description: One sentence on where it is — e.g. waiting for the daily city budget, and until when, or why it was paused.

top_places.description: Each { place, leads, basis }: basis "leads" — leads delivered there; or basis "businesses_checked" — leads null and businesses_checked the businesses checked there, when leads per place are not known.

title: Run an advanced search
